test_autotune_greedy: test the greedy autotuner algorithm on an LLVM environment with a cbench benchmark
run_autotuner_greedy: run the Autotuner with greedy algorithm to optimize codesize within a time limit
create_llvm_env: create an LLVM compiler gym environment with IrInstructionCount reward space
reset_env_benchmark: reset the compiler gym environment with a specific cbench benchmark target
validate_autotuner_result: validate autotuner results including benchmark, walltime, commandline, and episode reward
